name: ARENA BASS
tagline: Stadium-size subs, slap & pluck, reese growls and horns — 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: 808 subs, slap, reese, acid and horns
gumroad_title: ARENA BASS — Bass Synthesizer VST3 Plugin (70 Presets) | 808, Reese, Slap, Acid
summary: A VST3 bass synthesizer with eight synthesis engines (sine sub, slap, analog-style mono bass, reese, FM growl, acid, horns and kick) and 70 factory presets.
about: ARENA BASS generates every sound in real time — no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls, then run it through a multimode filter, envelopes, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Bass presets load in mono for clean one-note lines; the horn bank plays chords with up to 16 voices.
Built for Trap, Drill and Hip-Hop 808s, Afrotrap and Afro bass, G-Funk slides, Deep House and acid lines.

features.d: Sine sub with pitch knock, slap, analog-style mono bass, stadium reese, FM growl, acid rubber, horns and kick.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from 808 subs to stadium horns.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
On-screen keyboard, pitch bend and mod wheel.
Everything you make with it is yours.

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a Windows VST3 instrument. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any VST3-compatible host.
